test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative.**

I ______ only a few steps before I was forced to stop.
solution:
The correct answer is **"had walked."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the past perfect tense, indicating that an action had already taken place before another action in the past. (because of the **before clause**)
 
• **"Had walked"** is the correct form of the past perfect tense for the subject **"I".**
 
• This implies that the speaker had already walked a few steps before being forced to stop.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *I **had walked**__ only a few steps before I was forced to stop. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, **"have walked"**, is in the present perfect tense which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• Option 3, **"walk"**, is in the present tense and does not convey the past action that had already taken place.
 
• Option 4, **"walked"**, is in the simple past tense which is grammatically correct but does not convey the sense of an action that had already taken place before another past action.
